title: SpaceDeployCreatedPayload
description: space.deploy.created v1 (OpenVibe.Space, subject deploy dpl_…, visibility internal): an upload or a Git ingest became an immutable, content-addressed deploy in the ready state. It is not yet serving: space.deploy.activated follows when it is made active. No file contents or paths.

site.description: the site name (one DNS label; the site is served at <site>.openvibe.website)

source.description: how the deploy arrived: an archive or individual files, a private preview upload, or a Git ingest (always a preview)

manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of the deploy manifest (the content address of the whole deploy)
